title: Chicken Piccata with Lemon Caper Cream Sauce
description: Lightly floured chicken cutlets pan-seared and finished in a thick, glossy lemon caper cream sauce scaled for generous spooning.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast
ingredients.note: sliced or tenderized into thin cutlets

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: to taste, go light because capers and brine are salty

steps.title: Prep the citrus and capers
steps.text: Zest the lemons for {zest}, then juice them for {lemon}. Drain the capers and measure {capers} and {brine}. Have {broth} and {cream} measured and ready.

steps.title: Cut and season cutlets
steps.text: Slice {chicken} into thinner cutlets with the KitchenAid tenderizer or by butterflying. Season both sides evenly with {salt} and {pepper}.

steps.title: Dredge
steps.text: Lightly dredge the cutlets in {flour_dredge} and shake off the excess.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Heat a 12-inch HexClad skillet over medium-high heat with {oil} and {searbutter}. Cook the cutlets for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked to 160 to 162 degrees F. Transfer to a plate and tent loosely.

steps.title: Start the sauce base
steps.text: Reduce heat to medium and wipe out any dark flour bits if needed, leaving the pan warm. Melt {saucebutter}, add {garlic}, and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant without browning.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.text: Whisk in {flour_roux} and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until smooth and slightly nutty.

steps.title: Simmer broth and cream
steps.text: Slowly whisk in {broth} so there are no lumps, then whisk in {cream}. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Season the sauce
steps.text: Stir in {zest}, {umami}, and {brine}. Simmer 1 minute more to blend.

steps.title: Finish off the heat
steps.text: Remove the skillet from the heat. Stir in {lemon} and {capers}, then add {butterfin} and swirl until melted and glossy. Taste and adjust with {saucesalt} and {saucepepper}.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Return the chicken cutlets to the skillet just to warm and coat in the sauce, or spoon the sauce generously over the plated cutlets. Garnish with {parsley}.

notes: Target plating time 5:30 PM: prep citrus/cutlets at 5:00, sear at 5:05, start sauce at 5:15, finish and plate at 5:25-5:30. Lemon Caper Cream Sauce scaled 1.5x from the 2-serving mahi-mahi recipe to give generous sauce for 3 servings of cutlets and Cream Cheese Yukon Potatoes. Option A/B dairy swap: replace the 0.75 cup heavy cream with 0.75 cup half-and-half and whisk in 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp cold water at the simmer if extra body is needed.
